status: Both scoped follow-up fixes implemented and validated in working tree; uncommitted.

method.baseline: Exact pre-follow-up collector and RenderWorld copied-read helpers plus original scene copied-bounds getter embedded only by a disposable Vite transform. Baseline already includes the completed early outdoor-shadow query fix.
method.grounding: New admission summary and early class gate with original copied renderer reads.
method.measurement: Five matched rounds per shadow mode, three alternating variants per round; reverse order on alternate rounds. Each 1.5s settle then 4s capture. Forty-five windows.
method.attribution: Within-round baseline minus grounding isolates Fix 1; grounding minus borrow isolates Fix 2. This is a three-way crossover with live drift, not independent frozen workload pairs.
method.proof: Ten same-frame collector triples per shadow mode; ten mapped-pass triples. Complete serialized strings compared exactly after restoring selected roots and pose-input maps before each variant. Immutable staged draw units/resources use identity tokens; receiver arrays, ordered inputs, selected roots and pose matrices/colors are compared as values. Hashes are labels.
method.overhead: Both modes retain identical method-dispatch/prototype wrappers and build-only globals. Matrix/depth/particle counter wrappers removed before timing. No V8 sampling, readback, builds or heavy analysis during windows. Diagnostic wrappers create common overhead; normal production smoke is separate.
method.counts: Nine 2s work audits, normalized by each frame count. Raw mappedDepthRequests means prepares inside the outdoor PSSM feature, including analytic fallback, and is renamed shadowPassDepthRequests here. It is not a mapped-root or GPU-draw count.
method.frozenFixture: 300 real compiler/admission/depth-reference/geometry-resolver compositions, including unavailable publication. New class gate is outside geometry resolution; baseline applies the original class rule after depth preparation.
method.lifetime: Borrowed contribution/bounds valid synchronously before next scene mutation. Owned placement retained only at cold static compilation; inspection snapshots preserved.
method.residual: PSSM analytic fallback still uses depth preparation for geometry/outdoor-scope admission before color collection. It can include off-camera roots and cannot read the color-only summary. No new eligibility query/cache was added for that separate path.
method.productionSmoke: Normal npm build, original native GLES backend, five 4s windows with diagnostic globals absent; separate session, not causal timing evidence.

limits: Real source/physical compiler, new admission summary, depth reference and grounding geometry resolver; live full-renderer proof is captured separately.
No live indoor scene or camera movement tested.

validation.gpu: Outdoor PSSM and selection pass. Portal particle/transparency oracle fails identically in current, repeated current and preserved baseline.
validation.initialFailures: Corrected child-transform test misuse and an unrelated receiver argument removed by a broad edit before accepted checks. No failed timing windows retained.
